name: Incarnate Ancient Specter

duration.value: until the end of your next turn

text:
You invoke an ancient wraith to appear and fight by your side. This specter may be the spirit of some long-dead king or warlord. It occupies the space of a Medium creature and has a fly Speed of 40 feet.

Arrive (mental, visual) Kneel, Peons! The specter raises its hand, indicating that all foes should pay it obeisance. All enemies within a 60-foot emanation of the specter must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature kneels, dropping Prone as a free action.

Failure As success, and the creature can't Stand for the duration of the spell.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature also bows its head, becoming Dazzled for the duration of the spell.

Depart (auditory, emotion, mental) Listen and Weep The specter speaks, and though its words have no meaning, they convey a terrible tragedy. All living enemies that have both eyes and blood (or a reasonable equivalent) within a 30-foot emanation begin to weep tears of blood. They take 4d6 persistent,bleed damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a failure, a creature is also dazzled for as long as they take the persistent bleed damage.
